import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Identify the column for 'Not Documented' responses
not_documented_column = 'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'

# Extract the values for the 'Not Documented' column
not_documented_values = df[not_documented_column].values

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who mentioned that requirements are not documented at all
proportion_not_documented = np.mean(not_documented_values)

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((not_documented_values,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Extract the confidence interval
confidence_interval = bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

proportion_not_documented, confidence_interval

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Identify the column for 'Not Documented' responses
not_documented_column = 'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented'

# Encode the categorical values as numeric (1 for 'not quoted', 0 for 'quoted', and NaN for '-77')
df[not_documented_column] = df[not_documented_column].replace({'not quoted': 1, 'quoted': 0, '-77': np.nan})

# Drop rows with missing values
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=[not_documented_column])

# Count the number of respondents who selected 'not quoted'
not_quoted_count = df_clean[not_documented_column].sum()

# Count the total number of respondents
total_respondents = len(df_clean)

# Calculate the proportion of respondents who mentioned that requirements are not documented at all
proportion_not_documented = not_quoted_count / total_respondents

# Extract the values for the 'Not Documented' column
not_documented_values = df_clean[not_documented_column].values

# Perform bootstrapping to calculate the 95% confidence interval
bootstrap_result = bootstrap((not_documented_values,), np.mean, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Extract the confidence interval
confidence_interval = bootstrap_result.confidence_interval

proportion_not_documented, confidence_interval
